instrument.name: Action Research Arm Test
instrument.construct: upper-extremity activity capacity and arm-hand functional performance

rmd.cost_description: RMD lists purchase of a standardized commercial ARAT kit at approximately USD 875 in its 2023 review; the cost entry is equipment-related.

scoring.0: No part of the task is completed.
scoring.1: The task is completed only partially.
scoring.2: The task is completed but with marked difficulty or abnormally prolonged performance according to the adopted protocol.
scoring.3: The task is completed normally according to the adopted protocol.
scoring.missing_item_policy: Do not calculate a standardized total until all 19 item scores are explicitly recorded in the Rawafid sheet.

alternative_kit_2026.interpretation: A modified equipment set can achieve equivalent measurement properties when it is specifically validated; equipment substitutions should not be presumed equivalent by default.

rights.basis: RMD Cost=Not Free is treated as equipment cost, not a copyright ruling. Rawafid publishes an original scoring/QC sheet and independently paraphrased task descriptors. It does not reproduce a vendor form, standardized instruction wording, copyrighted manual layout, conversion table, or third-party training package.

arabic.rawafid_language_status: Operational Arabic paraphrase only; no validated or authorized Arabic ARAT form is claimed.
